about: check-size.mts --budgets: gzip bytes the browser downloads, per class, from dist/ after npm run build. JS is measured with Vite's 8-character chunk hashes replaced by a fixed string, so renaming a chunk does not move the totals. A size over its budget fails; a size more than 5% under fails until the budget is lowered, so budgets only go down. Reset 2026-11-06 at 5e78c96 plus #211 to the hash-stable measure plus 25 B (entry 33145, boot 1166495, workers 2565597, lazy 3048380); workers and lazy dropped by the shared POI data chunk (#211). 2026-11-06, #207 (?ktx2=etc1s, measured at its merge with 2465464): boot 1166520 to 1166546 (measured 1166536: the ktx2 flag becomes a text flag and assets.ts gates the lazy import on its two values), workers 2565622 to 2565676 (measured 2565666: the workers bundle client/src/flags.ts, whose ktx2 entry grows), lazy 3048405 to 3048451 (measured 3048441: the etc1s branch in the ktx2-tex chunk). Each is the measure plus 10 B. 2026-11-06, #169 (geofree restore, measured at its merge with e74cea1): entry 33170 to 33202 (measured 33192: the stream build queue in main.ts), boot 1166546 to 1166621 (measured 1166611), lazy 3048451 down to 3047949 (measured 3047939): the change moves 502 B out of lazy, so the three budgets together go down by 395 B.
